recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, low-key portrait of a man leaning against a textured, distressed wall. The image features a strong green-yellow color cast on the subject, contrasting against a deep black background. The composition is framed by a vertical strip of warm, textured light on the left and a thin red vertical line on the right, topped with two distinct styles of typography: a blocky, distressed sans-serif and a fluid, white script.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a vertical texture boundary
Contrast between organic human form and rigid geometric text alignment
Juxtaposition of high-saturation green skin tones against deep black negative space
Balance between heavy block lettering and delicate cursive script
coreInvariants: Vertical textured border on the left edge
Strong green/yellow color grade on the subject
Deep black background for the right two-thirds of the frame
Two-tier typographic hierarchy at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, positioned in the left half, leaning into the frame from a textured wall.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, highlighted by a sickly green glow, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left block text, move down the subject's face and body, then across to the script text and the thin red line on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the right side creates a sense of isolation and depth.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Acidic Green/Yellow (subject highlights and skin tones)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt Orange (block text) and Red (vertical line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and the background; high saturation in the green and orange elements against desaturated shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide, all-caps characters with irregular, eroded edges
Subtitle text uses a thin, connected script with varying baseline heights
Extreme letter spacing (tracking) in the display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the display text has a low crossbar and distressed terminals
Script 'f' and 't' have elongated, expressive cross-strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of heavy, distressed geometric forms with light, organic handwriting.
graphicDevices: Vertical red line acting as a secondary anchor
Textured border on the left edge with color bleeding

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, distressed, 90s-era blocky aesthetic
Provides the necessary fluid, informal script contrast

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-key portrait of a man in a light jacket leaning against a heavily textured, grunge-style wall on the left. Apply a strong lime-green and yellow duotone-style color grade to the man's skin and clothes. The right side of the image should be deep black with a single thin, glowing red vertical line near the right edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-tracked, all-caps block text in a distressed orange font at the very top. Below that, add a line of white, informal cursive script positioned slightly to the right.

verificationChecks: Is the green color cast prominent on the subject?
Is the top text widely spaced and distressed?
Is there a clear vertical texture on the left edge?
Does the script text contrast sharply with the block text?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green color cast
Amount of distress on the left wall texture
Tracking width of the display text
Position of the vertical red line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced use of heavy and light typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green tint doesn't look like a technical error but an intentional grade.
Check that the orange text is legible despite the distress.
Verify the black background is deep enough to provide high contrast.
Confirm the script text looks like natural handwriting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key, color-graded portrait with a textured vertical border and a two-tier typographic header consisting of wide-tracked distressed caps and organic script.
